visual_logic.surface_detail: Glistening, semi-aquatic skin with deep terracotta and rusty orange patterns, running uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.environment: Sluggish stream with thick clusters of Charophytes and giant Equisetites (horsetails). All plant and water elements are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The continuous spine, needle-teeth within the slender snout, and small flat paddle limbs are all aligned perfectly parallel to the frame edge.

pose: The small anapsid reptile is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original graceful 'S' shape on a mudbank is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its fanged snout, elongated torso, small paddle limbs (flattened toward the camera plane), and whip-like tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
